AUTH_SESSION_CHANGE.prose: A password change replaced the account's authentication session. Fluxer closes the Gateway sessions of the old authentication session before it sends this event, and they never receive it.

CALL_CREATE.prose: A call started in a private channel, or the session learned of an active one after Ready or a lost connection. Every recipient of the channel receives it, and the same goes for Call Update and Call Delete. Only after Ready or a lost connection

CALL_DELETE.prose: A call ended or became unavailable. Keep an unavailable call until a new Call Create arrives.

CALL_UPDATE.prose: Who is ringing, who is in the call or the call's region changed. The payload has the same fields as Call Create without `recipients` and `created_at`.

CHANNEL_CREATE.prose: A channel was created or the session can see it for the first time. The payload is the channel object.

CHANNEL_DELETE.prose: A channel was deleted or the session can no longer see it. The payload is the channel object as it was before. Remove every thread whose `parent_id` is the channel yourself, because Fluxer sends no Thread Delete for them.

CHANNEL_MEMBER_COUNTS_UPDATE.prose: The answer to Request Channel Member Counts. You only get an entry for a channel where you have `VIEW_CHANNEL_MEMBERS`.

CHANNEL_PINS_ACK.prose: The current user marked a channel's pins as seen.

CHANNEL_PINS_UPDATE.prose: A channel's most recent pin time changed.

CHANNEL_RECIPIENT_ADD.prose: A user joined a group direct message the session is in.

CHANNEL_RECIPIENT_REMOVE.prose: A user left a group direct message the session is in.

CHANNEL_UPDATE.prose: A visible channel changed. The payload is the channel object.

CHANNEL_UPDATE_BULK.prose: Several channels changed at once, usually in a reorder. Each session gets only the channels it can view.

ENTRANCE_SOUND_PLAY.prose: A participant played their entrance sound in the voice channel they are in. Everyone else with a voice state in the channel receives it.

FAVORITE_MEME_CREATE.prose: The current user saved a meme. The payload is the meme object.

FAVORITE_MEME_DELETE.prose: The current user deleted a meme.

FAVORITE_MEME_UPDATE.prose: One of the current user's memes changed. The payload is the meme object.

FORUM_UNREADS.prose: The answer to Request Forum Unreads. Each forum unread object has `thread_id` and either `count` or `missing`. `count` is the number of messages after the `ack_message_id` in the request, capped at 25. `missing` is true when the request had no valid `ack_message_id` for that post.

GUILD_AUDIT_LOG_ENTRY_CREATE.prose: An audit log entry was written. Every session with `VIEW_AUDIT_LOG` gets it. The payload is the audit log entry with `guild_id` added and any `ip` entry left out of `changes`. Treat a missing `options` or `changes` as empty.

GUILD_COUNTS_UPDATE.prose: The answer to Request Guild Counts. A guild that isn't connected or didn't answer in time has no entry.

GUILD_CREATE.prose: A guild became available to the session, for example after joining it or when an unavailable guild recovers. The payload is a guild ready object. Replace your stored `roles`, `channels`, `emojis`, `stickers`, `voice_states` and `threads` for the guild with the new arrays. `members` is partial, and you add or update those members and keep the others. A later Guild Create without `visiting` means the account joined.

GUILD_DELETE.prose: The session lost a guild, or the guild became unavailable. Only when the guild itself was deleted Without `unavailable`, delete everything you store for the guild. With `unavailable: true`, keep it as unavailable until a Guild Create arrives.

GUILD_EMOJIS_UPDATE.prose: A guild's emojis changed. Replace your stored emojis with the array.

GUILD_MEMBERS_CHUNK.prose: The answer to Request Guild Members. A request that matches nobody still gets one chunk with an empty `members`.

GUILD_MEMBER_ADD.prose: A user joined a guild. The payload is the guild member object with `guild_id` added.

GUILD_MEMBER_LIST_UPDATE.prose: A member list the session subscribed to with Lazy Request changed, and the event resends the subscribed ranges.

GUILD_MEMBER_REMOVE.prose: A user is no longer a member of a guild. Fluxer also sends a Thread Members Update for each thread they were in.

GUILD_MEMBER_UPDATE.prose: A member or their public profile changed. The payload is the guild member object with `guild_id` added.

GUILD_ROLE_UPDATE_BULK.prose: Several roles changed at once, usually in a reorder.

GUILD_STICKERS_UPDATE.prose: A guild's stickers changed. Replace your stored stickers with the array.

GUILD_SYNC.prose: The guild's full state again, sent after a Lazy Request asks for a sync or switches the guild between active and passive. The payload is a guild ready object, handled like Guild Create.

GUILD_UPDATE.prose: A guild's settings changed. The payload is the guild object with `guild_id` added. An unavailable guild sends no other event.

INVITE_CREATE.prose: An invite was created. The payload is the invite object with its invite metadata. A guild invite goes to sessions with `MANAGE_CHANNELS` on its channel, and a group direct message invite goes to every recipient.

INVITE_DELETE.prose: An invite was deleted. It goes to the same sessions as Invite Create.

MESSAGE_ACK.prose: The current user's read state moved forward in a channel, usually from another of their sessions.

MESSAGE_CREATE.prose: A message was created. The payload is the message object with these fields added. A published message also arrives as Message Create in each following channel, with the `IS_CROSSPOST` flag.

MESSAGE_DELETE.prose: A message was deleted. Absent when an instance admin or Fluxer itself deleted the message

MESSAGE_DELETE_BULK.prose: Several messages in one channel were deleted at once.

MESSAGE_REACTION_ADD.prose: A user reacted to a message.

MESSAGE_REACTION_ADD_MANY.prose: Reactions in private channels, grouped over 650 ms, for a session with the `DEBOUNCE_MESSAGE_REACTIONS` session flag. Each window keeps only the latest 512 reactions and drops older ones. Each event covers one message. A window with a single reaction sends Message Reaction Add.

MESSAGE_REACTION_REMOVE_ALL.prose: Every reaction on a message was removed.

MESSAGE_REACTION_REMOVE_EMOJI.prose: Every reaction with one emoji was removed from a message.

MESSAGE_UPDATE.prose: A message changed. The payload is the full message object and, in a guild channel, `guild_id` and `member` as in Message Create. Sessions need `READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY` unless the message is newer than the guild's message history cutoff.

PASSIVE_UPDATES.prose: Fluxer sends this every 30 seconds, when something changed, for a guild with more than 250 members where the session is passive.

PRESENCE_UPDATE.prose: A visible presence changed. The payload is a presence object. You get presences for friends, group direct message recipients and the guild members you name in a Lazy Request, as Presence subscriptions describes.

PRESENCE_UPDATE_BULK.prose: The online presences of a guild that was unavailable, sent right after the Guild Create that restores it.

RATE_LIMITED.prose: A bot sent Request Guild Members for the full member list of a guild more than once in 30 seconds. Only the requesting session receives it.

READY.prose: The session's initial state, sent once after a successful Identify. On a bot session every entry is `{"id": "...", "unavailable": true}`, and a Guild Create or Guild Delete for each one follows Ready Relationships in Ready have no `user`, and each guild member's `user` has only `id`. The full accounts are in `users`. A bot gets an empty `users`, its Guild Create burst after Ready has members with the same `{"id": "..."}` user, and it fetches the accounts with Request Guild Members. A later Guild Create and every Guild Sync have full members. Always empty for a bot session Shortly after Ready, the session gets a Call Create for each private channel with an active call.

RECENT_MENTION_DELETE.prose: The current user removed a message from their recent mentions.

RELATIONSHIP_ADD.prose: The current user has a new relationship. Only accurate in a Relationship Update sent by Modify voice activity sharing. List relationships always has the real value.

RELATIONSHIP_UPDATE.prose: A relationship changed. The payload has the same fields as Relationship Add.

RESUMED.prose: Sent after a successful Resume has replayed the missed Dispatches. Its `s` is the current sequence and the next live Dispatch adds one.

SAVED_MESSAGE_CREATE.prose: The current user saved a message. The payload is the message object.

SAVED_MESSAGE_DELETE.prose: The current user unsaved a message.

SESSIONS_REPLACE.prose: The account's live sessions changed. The payload is an array of every session presence object, and it replaces the `sessions` list from Ready.

THREAD_CREATE.prose: A thread is created or the session is added to one. The payload is the thread object with these fields. A passive session gets it only when its user is a member.

THREAD_DELETE.prose: A thread is deleted. A passive session gets it only when its user is a member.

THREAD_LIST_SYNC.prose: The session's active threads are replaced for a guild or for some of its channels. A user session that did not set `threads` gets only the threads it joined unless `channel_ids` is present. Fluxer sends it after Lazy Request sets `threads` to true and when the session gets view access to channels with active threads. Resume does not replay it.

THREAD_MEMBERS_UPDATE.prose: Users join or leave a thread. `member` is the guild member or null. `presence` is the presence object or null when the user is not visibly online. A passive session gets it only when its user was added or removed.

THREAD_MEMBER_LIST_UPDATE.prose: The full member list of a thread the session subscribed to with `thread_member_lists`. Resume does not replay it. Each item has `user_id`, `join_timestamp`, `flags`, `member` and `presence`. `presence` is a presence object with status `offline` when the user is not visibly online.

THREAD_MEMBER_UPDATE.prose: The session's own membership in a thread changes. The payload is the thread member object plus `guild_id`. Every session of the user that can view the thread receives it.

THREAD_UPDATE.prose: A thread changes, and the payload is the thread object. A message sent to an archived thread unarchives it and sends this event. A passive session gets it only for a thread it joined.

TYPING_START.prose: A user started typing. Typing is decided separately explains which sessions get it.

USER_CONNECTIONS_UPDATE.prose: The current user's external connections changed.

USER_GUILD_SETTINGS_UPDATE.prose: The notification settings for one guild changed. The payload is that guild's user guild settings object.

USER_NOTE_UPDATE.prose: The current user wrote or cleared a private note.

USER_PINNED_DMS_UPDATE.prose: The pinned private channels changed. The payload is an array of every pinned channel ID in order, and it replaces `pinned_dms` from Ready.

USER_SETTINGS_UPDATE.prose: The current user's settings changed. The payload is the user settings object.

USER_UPDATE.prose: The current user's account changed. The payload is the user object in its private representation.

VOICE_SERVER_UPDATE.prose: The session got a voice grant, sent only to the session that asked. A LiveKit grant has `token` and `endpoint`. A peer-to-peer grant has `p2p: true` and `ice_servers`, and you follow Peer-to-peer voice. Voice has the rest. On a LiveKit grant On a peer-to-peer grant On a LiveKit grant for an end-to-end encrypted channel A new grant comes when the connection opens, moves to another channel or changes region. A LiveKit grant for a connection that had a peer-to-peer grant means the call switched to LiveKit. Close your peer connections and connect with the new grant.

VOICE_SIGNAL.prose: Another connection in a peer-to-peer call sent this session a signaling message with the Voice Signal command. Only the session that owns the target connection receives it. Ignore a signal whose `from` is no longer in your roster. ```

VOICE_STATE_UPDATE.prose: A participant's voice state changed. The payload is a voice state object, and a null `channel_id` means they left.

WEBAUTHN_CREDENTIALS_UPDATE.prose: The current user's passkeys changed. The payload is an array of every WebAuthn credential object, and it replaces `webauthn_credentials` from Ready.

WEBHOOKS_UPDATE.prose: A guild channel's webhooks changed, including when a channel follow starts or ends. The event has no webhook data. Fetch the list with List channel webhooks.
